words.definition: to close or attach something firmly
words.example: Please fasten the boxes securely before loading them onto the truck.
words.exampleTranslation: 裝上卡車前，請把箱子牢牢綁緊。

words.definition: causing or likely to cause damage or injury
words.example: The new packaging avoids materials that are harmful to the environment.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的包裝避免使用對環境有害的材料。

words.definition: providing useful or interesting information
words.example: The orientation session was short but informative.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場新人說明會雖然短，但內容很豐富。

words.definition: an organization created for a particular purpose, often education or research
words.example: She trained at a culinary institute before opening her own restaurant.
words.exampleTranslation: 她在開自己的餐廳之前，曾在一所餐飲學院受訓。

words.definition: a set of tools, equipment, or parts for a particular purpose
words.example: Every technician carries a basic repair kit.
words.exampleTranslation: 每位技術人員都會攜帶一組基本維修工具。

words.definition: in or from the local area
words.example: We try to source ingredients locally whenever possible.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們盡量就近在當地採購食材。

words.definition: an experienced person who advises and guides a less experienced one
words.example: Every new hire is paired with a mentor for the first month.
words.exampleTranslation: 每位新進員工在第一個月都會配對一位導師。

words.definition: to formally propose someone for a position or award
words.example: Her manager nominated her for the employee-of-the-year award.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的主管提名她角逐年度最佳員工獎。

words.definition: to make a choice between two or more options
words.example: Employees can opt to receive their pay stub by email instead of paper.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工可以選擇用電子郵件收薪資單，而不是紙本。

words.definition: a public procession, often to celebrate an event
words.example: Downtown streets will be closed for the annual parade.
words.exampleTranslation: 市中心街道會因為年度遊行而封閉。

words.definition: a medical doctor, especially one who treats general illnesses
words.example: The clinic added a new physician to reduce patient wait times.
words.exampleTranslation: 診所新增了一位醫師，以縮短病患的等候時間。

words.definition: to make something smooth and shiny by rubbing it, or to refine and improve it
words.example: Take a few minutes to polish your presentation before the meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 在會議前花點時間把簡報再潤飾一下。

words.definition: the cost of sending mail through the postal system
words.example: Postage rates will increase starting next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 郵資費率從下個月開始調漲。

words.definition: relating to activities done for enjoyment when not working
words.example: The office added a recreational area with a ping-pong table.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室新增了一個有桌球桌的休閒區。

words.definition: to practice something, such as a speech or performance, before doing it for real
words.example: Let's rehearse the client pitch one more time before tomorrow.
words.exampleTranslation: 明天之前我們再排練一次客戶提案。

words.definition: the act of taking something away or off
words.example: The removal of the old equipment is scheduled for Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 舊設備的移除作業排在星期五。

words.definition: acceptable and meeting expectations
words.example: The inspection results were satisfactory, so the shipment was approved.
words.exampleTranslation: 檢驗結果令人滿意，所以這批貨獲准出貨。

words.definition: relating to or occurring during a particular season of the year
words.example: We hire extra seasonal staff during the holiday rush.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們在假期購物潮期間會多聘僱季節性人力。

words.definition: apart from something else, not together
words.example: Please invoice the two orders separately.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把這兩筆訂單分開開立發票。

words.definition: the rate at which employees leave a company, or the total amount of business done
words.example: Staff turnover has decreased since we introduced flexible hours.
words.exampleTranslation: 自從我們實施彈性工時後，員工流動率就降低了。
